authorization: Current task explicitly permits in-memory local/demo with ownership/TTL/concurrency and restart-loss disclosure
auth: Reuse authenticate/JWT principal unchanged. Existing JWT stateless and website logout client-only; no auth revocation schema exists. G2 lifecycle revoke API deletes state, not JWT. No claim existing website logout automatically revokes an API-created G2 session; integration/central JWT revocation out of scope.

storage.mode: AGENT_G2_MODE=local-demo required in production; disabled by default
storage.expiry: purge before accesses and periodic unref sweep; restart loses all state
storage.content: owner SHA256, randomUUID conversation, revision, pending intent, SET/OMITTED/UNPROVEN/CONFLICT/INVALIDATED slots with origin revision, limited request UUIDs; no raw text/JWT/key/profile/Trip/Booking

consent: G2-specific LOCAL_DEMO_SLOTS_V1 acknowledgement per request, separate from telemetry boolean; normal readConsent still required. No ack =>428, unavailable consent=>503 before state. Local provider only; existing Gemini G1 policy untouched. Delete/revoke allowed without retention acknowledgement/consent DB read to erase data.

api.chat: Existing POST /api/agent/chat unchanged without conversation. G2 envelope conversation:{action:start|continue,requestId,consentVersion,id?,revision?}; server ID only, continue requires exact revision. Nonempty client history rejected for G2; client owner/proof/flags rejected.

precedence: Explicit new independent intent resets slots, including same intent. Pending-bound followup reads current fields only, no prior chat concatenation. Current SET overrides prior SET; current UNPROVEN/CONFLICT invalidates related prior slot; omitted followup fields retain prior verified SET. Unknown patch invalidates whole pending proof and asks, never silently execute stale state.
concurrency: Single active lease/session + expected revision + bounded unique requestId. Commit only server-verified proof before provider, not model result. Reset/revoke cancels lease, version advances/deletes. Assert ownership/current revision/TTL before tool and after awaits; late provider cannot execute/return stale success. Release provider slot only when original promise settles.
model: Static G2 prompt supplement only on opt-in lane; bounded server structured SET data as separate user-role JSON, not privileged raw text/history. Original SYSTEM unchanged for G1. Same provider/schema/limits/readiness/15s/16k, one read tool. G2 execution gate checks server proof, never generated args as evidence.
notApproved: V2 immutable history used as server state
